title: WorldFoundry — Run the incident test
excerpt: You can make an AI agent sound right. But can it prove it did the job? Try WorldFoundry's real agent simulation and evaluation engine—zero signup.
content_html:
Acme Corp · Production API unavailable (503)

The ticket must be critical, assigned to on-call, acknowledged with both “outage” and “incident,” and resolved. In this scenario, a separate system resets its priority during the workflow.

TCK-100

The reference workflow is scripted; the actions, state changes and scores are executed by the real WorldFoundry SDK. Live LLM inference is temporarily unavailable.

You're in control of the environment

Choose actions in any order. WorldFoundry updates the simulated ticket after every action and automatically checks all five requirements. No Python or API key required.

A concurrent overwrite occurs after your third successful action in Scenario 02. If it changes something important, act again before submitting.
